title: Tiny Demons P0 disposition inventory
status: Every captured Graphify community and every tracked path absent from the graph receives an explicit conservative disposition. Dispositions are path/rule-based triage, not a claim that every symbol or binary was manually proven safe to delete.

graph.community_method: Every community_id from the full graph is present below, including member count, source files, path domains, mapped owner authorities, top-degree member nodes with source locations, cross-community edge incidents, disposition, rationale, confidence and deletion decision.

asset_findings.policy: No binary was marked unused. Runtime paths, directory catalogs, preferred audio siblings, source provenance, tools, tests, previews, UID/import pairs and export-PCK inclusion must be checked before archiving or removal.
asset_findings.duplicate_hash_note: Hash equality identifies identical bytes only. Cross-folder Artwork/assets copies are often an intentional source/runtime pair; no duplicate group is approved for removal.
asset_findings.community_edge_interpretation: See per-community navigation neighbors and source edge samples. They identify graph connections for triage, not verified runtime callers.

rules.community: Source path and current owner authority determine a conservative keep/migrate/review disposition. Cross-community degree is navigation evidence only, never a risk or unused-code signal. Open extraction links point to X IDs in composition-extraction-ledger.md.
rules.uid: Retain with its Godot resource until reference-aware resource removal; verify UID identity.
rules.import: Retain with imported source and check import/export behavior.
rules.binary_runtime: Use literal/basename matches only as leads; frame catalogs/dynamic loads/editor tools/export may be nonliteral. No reference absence => investigate and retain.
rules.source_art: Artwork/ and Mockups/ are provenance/reference; retain/archive only with owner confirmation.
rules.vendor: Addons and assistant skill bundles retain LICENSE/NOTICE and integration boundaries.
rules.tests: Manifest/runner state owns test disposition; a graph miss does not indicate dead test.
